xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4224: Primary main keeps diverging: plan-artifact push lands on origin but local main can't follow (untracked .pan files block reset --keep)

plan.title: Primary main keeps diverging: plan-artifact push lands on origin but local main can't follow (untracked .pan files block reset --keep)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pushPlanArtifacts (src/lib/overdeck/plan-artifact-commit.ts) pushes backlog-sequence and order-book commits from the primary checkout. When origin gained a .pan/ file through a PR merge that the primary holds untracked, the push landed but the follow step (git reset --keep) was refused. Every later write then replayed already-landed commits, which produced empty duplicates (a4ae61d3bf7) or conflicts, so local main drifted further and the warning went only to CLI stderr. The untracked files exist because complete-planning promotes the workspace PRD draft into the primary checkout instead of onto the feature branch (planning-promotion.ts:673).
narratives.Proposal: Make pushPlanArtifacts replay only commits not already upstream (rev-list --cherry-pick --right-only), skip empty replays, and self-heal to origin when every local commit already landed. Before the follow, set aside colliding untracked .pan/ files: delete the identical ones after a successful reset, keep non-identical ones under <planHome>/.overdeck/plan-artifact-backups/<stamp>/ (a self-ignoring root), and restore everything if the reset still fails. Surface every push problem as a warn activity entry through a shared helper that both CLI callers use. Promote the PRD draft into the workspace plan home, so the planning commit carries it on the feature branch, and point the planning prompt and the PRD-gate message at the workspace path. Update docs/XBRIEF.md, reference/troubleshooting.mdx and the codebase concerns map.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Moving continue/spec/feedback/slot-ledger writers and readers off the primary checkout (filed as PAN-4225)
- Clearing tracked .pan/ files with local modifications that block the follow; they produce a surfaced warning instead
- A one-time cleanup of untracked files already in the primary checkout
- Any change to how commitPlanArtifacts stages or commits
- A persistent 'diverged' badge in the workspace UI
- Using git stash, git clean, force-push, or --no-verify anywhere in the push path

autoDecisions.summary: Split the continue/spec writers into sibling issue PAN-4225
autoDecisions.rationale: A census found about 10 writers across cloister, lifecycle, CLI start/scope and swarm that pass the primary root, and readers (handoff-context.ts:124, test-skip-waiver.ts:47) that read the primary copy. Moving the writes alone would break feedback delivery, and the redesign exceeds the finalize size lint. The robust push makes their collisions survivable meanwhile.

autoDecisions.summary: Clear only untracked colliding .pan/ files; tracked-modified collisions stay a surfaced refusal
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names untracked files only. Discarding an operator's working-tree edit, even with a backup, is not authorized by the issue, and the dashboard warning now names the blocking path.

autoDecisions.summary: Back up non-identical files under <planHome>/.overdeck/plan-artifact-backups/<stamp>/ with a .gitignore containing '*' at the root
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a backup under .overdeck/. .overdeck/ is not wholly ignored in every plan home (Overdeck tracks .overdeck/context/codebase/), so a self-ignoring root keeps backups out of git status in any repo.

autoDecisions.summary: Surface problems with emitActivityEntryOncePortable, source 'plan-artifacts', level warn, id derived from sha1(planHome + message)
autoDecisions.rationale: This is the existing CLI-to-dashboard activity path (used by /pan reload). A deterministic id keeps a repeated failure from spamming the feed. The console print stays as the fallback when the dashboard is down.

autoDecisions.summary: Refuse to push when local main holds merge commits over upstream
autoDecisions.rationale: The replay rebuilds single-parent commits only. A merge commit cannot be replayed safely, and plan-home verbs never create one.

autoDecisions.summary: Promotion copies a primary-only draft into the workspace plan home and never deletes the primary copy
autoDecisions.rationale: This brings older primary-only drafts onto the feature branch without destroying the operator's file. When the PR merges, the robust follow clears the now-identical untracked copy.

items.title: pushPlanArtifacts replays only commits not already on the upstream and self-heals when all landed

expected_outputs: plan-artifact-commit.test.ts passes including the three new WI-1 tests

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 in src/lib/overdeck/plan-artifact-commit.ts. Keep `local = rev-list --reverse onto..head` for the not-ahead skip. Refuse when `rev-list --merges onto..head` is non-empty (reason contains 'merge commits'). Compute `pending = rev-list --reverse --cherry-pick --right-only --no-merges <onto>...<head>` (three dots) and run the .pan/-only check over pending only. If pending is empty, skip the push and move the branch onto `onto` with reset --keep, returning { pushed:false, skipped:true, reason:'<branch> was already on <upstream>; moved <branch> onto it' }. If that move fails, return skipped:false with 'could not move … run git pull --rebase in <cwd>'. In the replay loop over pending, skip commit-tree when the merge-tree result equals `<tip>^{tree}`. If nothing was replayed, follow without pushing. Keep the fast-forward path. Add the three WI-1 tests named in the PRD to the existing describe('pushPlanArtifacts') harness. Async execFile only, no stash, no force.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2 in src/lib/overdeck/plan-artifact-commit.ts. Add `backedUp?: readonly { path; backup }[]` to the pushed:true variant and to the skipped:true variant of PushPlanArtifactsResult. Add a non-exported `followTip(cwd, branch, head, tip)` used by both follow paths (replayed push and the all-landed self-heal from push-skip-landed). It runs: HEAD-moved check; `git diff --name-only --no-renames --diff-filter=A -z HEAD <tip> -- .pan/` ∩ `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z -- .pan/`; for each collision, compute identical = (git hash-object <file>) === (git rev-parse <tip>:<path>) BEFORE moving; fs.rename it to <cwd>/.overdeck/plan-artifact-backups/<stamp>/<path> (stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-')), creating <backupRoot>/.gitignore with '*\n' if missing; `git reset --quiet --keep <tip>`; on success delete identical backups and the empty stamp dir, return the non-identical ones; on failure rename every backup back and return the error's first line. Keep the existing 'pushed, but could not move … run git pull --rebase in <cwd>' warning text. Update the module header and the pushPlanArtifacts JSDoc. Never git stash or git clean. Add the three WI-2 tests from the PRD, including the issue acceptance test.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-3. Add 'plan-artifacts' to the ActivitySource union in src/lib/activity-logger.ts. Create src/lib/overdeck/plan-artifact-push-report.ts exporting describePlanArtifactPush(push) → {message, details?} | null and surfacePlanArtifactPush(push, {planHome, command}). describe rules: pushed with warning → warning; pushed:false skipped:false → reason; backedUp non-empty on either success variant → append 'moved N untracked .pan/ file(s) that differed from origin to <backup dir>' with details listing 'path -> backup' lines; otherwise null. surface calls emitActivityEntryOncePortable({ id: 'plan-artifact-push:' + first 12 hex of sha1(planHome + '\n' + message), source: 'plan-artifacts', level: 'warn', command, message: `Plan home ${planHome}: ${message}`, details }), ignores the outcome, and returns the description. Replace the inline warning logic at src/cli/index.ts:302-306 (label 'Sequence push', command 'pan backlog write-sequence') and src/cli/commands/orders.ts:76-78 (label 'Order book push', command 'pan orders') with the helper, keeping the chalk.yellow stderr line. Write the unit tests in the PRD with vi.mock of activity-logger.
